sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a canonical controlled value for “other ice-strengthened areas”; hullArea is a datatype property, while frame and ship are classes.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the convenience bowFormApplicability boolean and the Applicable/NonApplicable branches; applicability must be determined directly from buttockAngle > 0 and < 80 degrees together with normalFrameAngle > 10 degrees, without requiring separately asserted branch-selection evidence. For other ice-strengthened areas, replace the presence-only OPTIONAL query with SHACL Core presence/unit constraints plus one bounded formula check relating nonBowLoadPatchLength to nonBowLoadPatchHeight using AR = length/height = 3.6. Constrain the reported loadPatchAspectRatio regulatory constant with equal sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive decimal bounds of 3.6, and check the derived dimension relationship using tolerance scaled from the expected value (3.6 × height), not exact derived equality or tolerance based on the reported value. Ensure missing operands, duplicate/conflicting values, or wrong units cannot produce a pass.

Replace the tautological sh:or with the actual conjunctive bow-form criterion: buttockAngle must be > 0 and < 80 degrees and normalFrameAngle must be > 10 degrees when this applicability check is invoked; do not add negated branches that let non-applicable values pass. Scope clause (iv) to the supplied hullArea evidence for other ice-strengthened areas instead of unconditionally requiring its parameters on every ship. Add sh:maxCount 1 to averageIcePressure. The ratio constant and tolerance-scaled formula are otherwise directionally correct. Presence of averageIcePressure alone does not encode that Pavg, bNonBow, and wNonBow are determined independently of hull shape; locate and use canonical evidence/provenance terms for that obligation rather than inventing a boolean or treating mere quantity presence as proof.

Remove the sh:or branch that lets every ship with no hullArea pass. Require explicit branch-selection evidence and match the canonical controlled value for “other ice-strengthened areas”; locate that value with the matcher. Apply the Pavg, bNonBow, wNonBow, and fixed AR=3.6 obligations only to that explicitly selected area. Encode the aspect-ratio formula in the regulatory direction (AR = height/length, hence height = 3.6 × length) using tolerance scaled from the expected derived value; the candidate currently reverses it. Also treat the buttock- and normal-frame-angle envelope as an applicability condition, not unconditional limits that every ship must satisfy.
